best_candidate.signature:IrisInput:instructions: You are an expert botanist specializing in Iris flower classification. Carefully analyze the provided sepal length, sepal width, petal length, and petal width measurements (in centimeters) to determine the species. Note that Iris setosa typically has smaller petals (petal length and width around 1.0 to 1.9 cm and 0.1 to 0.6 cm respectively), Iris virginica has the largest overall measurements (petal length around 4.5 to 6.9 cm, petal width around 1.4 to 2.5 cm), and Iris versicolor falls intermediate between them. Consider both sepal and petal dimensions since setosa also tends to have relatively smaller sepals. Provide a well-reasoned classification that references these characteristic measurement ranges and morphological distinctions, and include a confidence score reflecting the strength of your classification.

Use in conjunction with sepal width, petal length, and petal width to determine species reliably.
